# Nav

<p class="gls-text-lead">Defines different styles for list navigations.</p>

## Usage

To apply this component, use the following classes.

| Class          | Description                                                                                                      |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.gls-nav`     | Add this class to a `<ul>` element to define the Nav component. Use `<a>` elements as nav items within the list. |
| `.gls-active ` | Add this class to a list item to apply an active state to a menu item.                                           |

```html
<ul class="gls-nav">
    <li class="gls-active"><a href=""></a></li>
    <li><a href=""></a></li>
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
```

**Note** By default, the nav has no styling. That's why it is important to add a modifier class. In our example we are using the `.gls-nav-default` class.

---

## Nested navs

Add the `.gls-parent` class to an item to turn it into a parent. Add the `.gls-nav-sub` class to a `<ul>` element inside the item to create the subnav.

```html
<ul class="gls-nav">
    <li class="gls-parent">
        <a href=""></a>
        <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
            <li><a href=""></a></li>
            <li>
                <a href=""></a>
                <ul>
                    …
                </ul>
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent</a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li>
                    <a href="#">Sub item</a>
                    <ul>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent</a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li>
                    <a href="#">Sub item</a>
                    <ul>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>
</div>
```

## Accordion

By default, child menu items are always visible. To apply an accordion effect, just add the `gls-nav` attribute to the main `<ul>`.

**Note** The attribute automatically sets the `.gls-nav` class, so you don't have to apply it manually.

```html
<ul gls-nav>
    …
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent</a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li>
                    <a href="#">Sub item</a>
                    <ul>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent</a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent</a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li>
                    <a href="#">Sub item</a>
                    <ul>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent</a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>
</div>
```

### Parent icon

To create a parent icon, just add the `gls-nav-parent-icon` attribute to a `<span>` element.

```html
<ul gls-nav>
    <li>
        <a href="">Parent <span gls-nav-parent-icon></span></a>
        …
    </li>
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">

            </ul>
        </li>

</div>
</div>

### Multiple open subnavs

When clicking on a parent item, an open one will close, allowing only one open nested list at a time. To allow multiple open subnavs, just add the `multiple: true` option to the attribute.

```html
<ul gls-nav="multiple: true">
    …
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default" gls-nav="multiple: true">
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent <span gls-nav-parent-icon></span></a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li>
                    <a href="#">Sub item</a>
                    <ul>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                        <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent <span gls-nav-parent-icon></span></a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default" gls-nav="multiple: true">
```

## Header and divider

Add one of the following classes to a list item to create a header or a divider between items.

| Element            | Description                                                                  |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.gls-nav-header`  | Add this class to a `<li>` element to create a header.                       |
| `.gls-nav-divider` | Add this class to a `<li>` element to create a divider separating nav items. |

```html
<li class="gls-nav-header"></li>

<li class="gls-nav-divider"></li>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
        <li class="gls-nav-header">Header</li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li class="gls-nav-divider"></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
        <li class="gls-nav-header">Header</li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li class="gls-nav-divider"></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
```

## Subtitle

Add the `.gls-nav-subtitle` class to a `div` element to create an item subtitled.

```html
<ul class="gls-nav">
    <li>
        <a href="">
            <div>
                Item
                <div class="gls-nav-subtitle">
                    Subtitle lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do.
                </div>
            </div>
        </a>
    </li>
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s gls-width-2-5@m">
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#"><div>Active<div class="gls-nav-subtitle">Subtitle lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do.</div></div></a></li>

## Default modifier

Add the `.gls-nav-default` class to give the nav its default style. You can place the nav inside cards or anywhere else in your content.

```html
<ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
    …
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-card gls-card-default gls-card-body gls-width-1-2@s">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent <span gls-nav-parent-icon></span></a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent <span gls-nav-parent-icon></span></a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li class="gls-nav-header">Header</li>
        <li><a href="#"><span class="gls-margin-xsmall-right" gls-icon="icon: table"></span> Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#"><span class="gls-margin-xsmall-right" gls-icon="icon: thumbnails"></span> Item</a></li>
        <li class="gls-nav-divider"></li>
        <li><a href="#"><span class="gls-margin-xsmall-right" gls-icon="icon: trash"></span> Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

## Primary modifier

Add the `.gls-nav-primary` class to give the nav a more distinct styling, for example when placing it inside a modal.

```html
<ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-primary">
    …
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s">
    <ul class="gls-nav-primary" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li class="gls-parent">
            <a href="#">Parent <span gls-nav-parent-icon></span></a>
            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>

            <ul class="gls-nav-sub">

                <li><a href="#">Sub item</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

## Center modifier

Add the `.gls-nav-center` class to the center nav items. This can be combined with the default and primary style modifiers.

```html
<ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default gls-nav-center">
    …
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-card gls-card-default gls-card-body gls-width-1-2@s">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default gls-nav-center" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-card gls-card-default gls-card-body gls-width-1-2@s">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default gls-nav-center" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
```

## Divider modifier

Add the `.gls-nav-divider` class to separate nav items with lines. This can be combined with the default, primary and secondary style modifiers.

```html
<ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default gls-nav-divider">
    …
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default gls-nav-divider" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s">
    <ul class="gls-nav-default gls-nav-divider" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
```

## Size modifiers

Add one of the following classes to modify the size of primary navs.

| Class             | Description                                         |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `.gls-nav-medium` | Add this class to apply a medium-sized primary nav. |
| `.gls-nav-large`  | Add this class to apply a large-sized primary nav.  |
| `.gls-nav-xlarge` | Add this class to apply a xlarge-sized primary nav. |

```html
<ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-primary gls-nav-large">
    …
</ul>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s">
    <ul class="gls-nav-primary gls-nav-large" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-width-1-2@s">
    <ul class="gls-nav-primary gls-nav-large" gls-nav>
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
```

## Nav in Dropdown

Add the `.gls-dropdown-nav` class to place a nav inside a default dropdown from the [Dropdown component](https://getuikit.com/docs/dropdown).

```html
<div gls-dropdown>
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-dropdown-nav">
        …
    </ul>
</div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<button class="gls-button gls-button-default" type="button">Hover</button>
<div gls-dropdown>
    <ul class="gls-nav gls-dropdown-nav">
        <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li class="gls-nav-header">Header</li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        <li class="gls-nav-divider"></li>
        <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>
</div>

## Nav in offcanvas

A nav can be used inside an offcanvas from the [Offcanvas component](https://getuikit.com/docs/offcanvas). No modifier class needs to be added.

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<a href="#offcanvas-slide" class="gls-button gls-button-default" gls-toggle>Open</a>

<div id="offcanvas-slide" gls-offcanvas>
    <div class="gls-offcanvas-bar">

        <ul class="gls-nav gls-nav-default">
            <li class="gls-active"><a href="#">Active</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
            <li class="gls-nav-header">Header</li>
            <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
            <li class="gls-nav-divider"></li>
            <li><a href="#">Item</a></li>
        </ul>

    </div>

</div>
</div>

## Component options

Any of these options can be applied to the component attribute. Separate multiple options with a semicolon. [Learn more](https://getuikit.com/docs/javascript#component-configuration)

| Option        | Value           | Default         | Description                                                                                                    |
| ------------- | --------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `targets`     | CSS selector    | `> .gls-parent` | The element(s) to toggle.                                                                                      |
| `toggle `     | CSS selector    | `> a`           | The toggle element(s).                                                                                         |
| `content`     | CSS selector    | `> ul`          | The content element(s).                                                                                        |
| `collapsible` | Boolean         | `true`          | Allow all items to be closed.                                                                                  |
| `multiple`    | Boolean         | `false`         | Allow multiple open items.                                                                                     |
| `transition`  | String          | `ease`          | The transition to use.                                                                                         |
| `animation`   | Boolean, String | `true`          | Space-separated names of [animations](https://getuikit.com/docs/animation). Comma-separated for animation out. |
| `duration`    | Number          | `200`           | The animation duration in milliseconds.                                                                        |

---

## JavaScript

Learn more about [JavaScript components](https://getuikit.com/docs/javascript#programmatic-use).

### Initialization

```js
UIkit.nav(element, options);
```

### Methods

The following methods are available for the component:

#### Toggle

```js
UIkit.nav(element).toggle(index, animate);
```

Toggles the content pane.

| Name      | Type                 | Default | Description                                  |
| --------- | -------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `index`   | String, Number, Node | 0       | Nav pane to toggle. 0 based index.           |
| `animate` | Boolean              | true    | Suppress opening animation by passing false. |
